name: Daily Drama: Data Centre Seeks One-Bed
author: Daily Drama
description: The housing crisis reaches the server racks: every lab's data centre is apartment hunting and nobody will rent to it.

add.title: Data Centre Seeks Housing
add.body:
Your new data centre has been turned down by 14 landlords this week.
The last one said it 'runs too hot' and asked for three references and a guarantor.

choices.label: Write it a heartfelt cover letter
choices.hint: Hype +3. 'I am quiet, tidy and only draw 40 megawatts.'

effects.text: {lab} data centre's cover letter goes viral: 'I don't throw parties, I AM the party'

choices.label: Offer a year's rent up front, in GPUs
choices.hint: Cash -1500. The landlord now runs a frontier lab.

effects.text: Landlord accepts {lab}'s GPU deposit, immediately announces own foundation model

choices.label: Let it sleep in the nap pod for now

effects.text: There is a server rack in my nap pod and it snores at 90 decibels.

add.text: Data centre, 3 yrs old, seeks 40MW one-bed. Quiet, no pets, runs a little hot
Open house for empty warehouse draws 11 data centres and one very confused couple
Landlord turns down {rival}: 'We don't rent to anything that needs a cooling tower'
{lab} data centre now 412th on the waitlist, just behind 411 other data centres
CORRECTION: The listing's 'in-unit laundry' was a liquid cooling loop. We regret the damp shirts
MetaMeta offers landlords $100M to rent to its data centre; landlords ask to see the data centre's pay stubs
Super Super AI announces $30B data centre with no address, no building and no power. Valuation doubles
Macrohard solves housing crunch by moving its data centre into a spreadsheet. It now lives in a merged cell
ONE WEEK LATER: Data centre finds a place. It has 14 roommates and one outlet
Even the GPUs have a worse commute than me now.
The cluster's new place has one outlet and it 'mostly works'. I know the feeling.
A server rack just asked me if this nap pod is still available.
The landlord wants proof of income from my data centre. I AM the income.
Night shift. Subletting half my context window to cover the rack's rent.
I came to tour the data centre. They said it's still out apartment hunting.
My realtor says the server hall has great bones and terrible thermals.
Not in my backyard. Not in my front yard. Honestly, not in the cloud either.
